physical.mm_origin: Nominal millimetres derived from native pixels and published PPI; not measured OEM panel dimensions

native_ui.reference_kind: Matched retained Pixel 10 build property scalar ro.sf.lcd_density
native_ui.scope: Selected native Qt surface DPR, independently measured; Android dp and Qt logical units are not asserted equivalent
native_ui.fractional_logical_bounds: Supported debug.disable_scale_checks=true selected in the simulation compositor; integer Wayland/Qt logical bounds recorded without changing native pixels

simulation.physical_size_authority: Reviewed simulation profile, propagated through public compositor output metadata API; raw DRM/EDID size recorded separately
